hadi-march/landing#BeforeAfter.name: BeforeAfter

props.name: before
props.doc: The first layer (start / top side): an image, a mock, any node.

props.name: after
props.doc: The second layer (end / bottom side).

props.name: value
props.doc: Divider position, 0–100 from the start (default 50).

props.name: orientation
props.doc: `horizontal`: the divider is vertical and moves across (default) · `vertical`: it moves down.

props.name: follow
props.doc: The divider follows the pointer while it is over the area (no press needed).

props.name: hint
props.doc: Sway once when first visible (default true).

props.doc: Accessible name of the handle (default "Before and after").

hadi-march/landing#BranchingStory.name: BranchingStory
hadi-march/landing#BranchingStory.doc: `<BranchingStory start="intro" passages={{ intro: { body: "…", choices: [{ label: "Go", to: "next" }] }, next: { body: "The end", ending: "Short" } }} />`

props.name: passages
props.doc: Passages by id.

props.name: start
props.doc: Id of the first passage.

props.name: path
props.doc: The path (passage ids from the start), to restore or drive it from outside.

props.name: trail
props.doc: Show the trail of choices (default true).

props.name: endings
props.doc: Count the endings found (default true).

props.name: action
props.doc: Shown at an ending, next to "Start again" (a call to action).

props.name: minHeight
props.doc: Minimum stage height (CSS length, default "20rem"): passages of different length do not move the page.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name (default "Story").

props.name: labels
props.type: { /** Accessible name of the trail (default "Your path"). */ path?: string; /** First step of the trail (default "Start"). */ start?: unknown; endings?: (found: number, total: number) => unknown; /** Body of a passage id that does not exist. */ missing?: unknown; /** Heading of an ending without a title or a name (default "The end"). */ end?: unknown; /** Before the ending's name in its badge (default "Ending: "). */ endingPrefix?: unknown; /** The button at an ending (default "Start again"). */ restart?: unknown; } | undefined
props.doc: Every text the story writes itself; the defaults are translated. `endings` gets the found and the total count.

props.name: restart
props.doc: The "Start again" button at an ending (default true).

props.name: keys
props.doc: Number keys 1–9 pick a choice, and each choice shows its number (default true).

props.name: renderChoice
props.doc: Draw the content of a choice button yourself (the button, its key and its motion stay).

props.name: transition
props.type: "turn" | "slide" | "fade" | "none" | ((side: 1 | -1) => { leave: Record<string, unknown[]>; enter: Record<string, unknown[]>; duration?: number; easing?: string }) | undefined
props.doc: How the page changes: "turn" (default: a 3D page turn), "slide", "fade", "none", or your own keyframes for the leaving and the entering passage; `side` is 1 forward and -1 back (already mirrored in RTL).

hadi-march/landing#compareRow.tr: Bir karşılaştırma satırında ürünün durumu: 1 önde, 0 eşit, -1 geride, null puanlanmıyor.

props.name: from
props.doc: First value counted from (default 0).

props.name: format
props.doc: Intl.NumberFormat options (currency, percent, compact notation …), e.g. a currency format with "EUR".

props.name: decimals
props.doc: Fixed decimals (shortcut for minimum/maximumFractionDigits).

props.name: mode
props.doc: `count`: the number counts (default) · `roll`: each digit rolls like an odometer · `none`: the value just changes.

props.name: duration
props.doc: ms (default 1600 for count, 900 for roll).

props.name: easing
props.doc: Easing of the count (a motion easing name or token, default "expo").

props.name: start
props.doc: Start when visible (default) or at once.

hadi-march/landing#Counter.tr: Sayaç: `<Counter value={12500} />`, `<Counter value={$price} mode="roll" format={EUR} />` (format: Intl.NumberFormat seçenekleri).

hadi-march/landing#CtaBand.name: CtaBand
hadi-march/landing#CtaBand.doc: `<CtaBand title="Ready to build?" lead="…" actions={[{ label: "Start free", href: "/start" }]} variant="gradient" />`

props.name: video
props.type: { src: string; poster?: string | undefined } | undefined

props.name: backdrop
props.doc: The decorative layers behind the copy (gradient, mesh, glass, grid, pointer light): default true; false: a bare panel.

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance of the panel when it scrolls into view (default "scale"): a Reveal effect, your own `{ from, to }`, or "none".

hadi-march/landing#CtaBand.tr: Çağrı bandı: `<CtaBand title="…" lead="…" actions={[{ label: "Başla", href: "/start" }]} variant="gradient" />`.

hadi-march/landing#Faq.name: Faq
hadi-march/landing#Faq.doc: `<Faq items={[{ q: "Is it free?", a: "Yes, MIT." }]} layout="split" title="Questions" search />`

props.name: title
props.doc: split: heading, lead and a contact line beside the questions.

props.name: search
props.doc: Search box above the questions.

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Several open at once (default false).

props.name: labels
props.type: { /** Placeholder and accessible name of the search box (default "Search questions"). */ search?: string; count?: (shown: number, total: number) => unknown; /** Shown when no question matches. */ empty?: unknown; } | undefined
props.doc: Every text the block writes itself; the defaults are translated. `count` gets the shown and the total number.

props.name: count
props.doc: The "3 of 12 questions" line under the search box (default true).

props.name: reveal
props.doc: split: entrance of the heading column (default "up"): a Reveal effect, your own `{ from, to }`, or "none".

hadi-march/landing#Faq.tr: Sık sorulan sorular: `<Faq items={[{ q: "Ücretsiz mi?", a: "Evet, MIT." }]} layout="split" title="Sorular" search />`.

hadi-march/landing#FeatureGrid.name: FeatureGrid
hadi-march/landing#FeatureGrid.doc: `<FeatureGrid items={[{ icon: zap, title: "Fast", body: "…" }]} variant="cards" cols={3} />`

props.name: cols
props.doc: Columns (cards / plain: 2–4, default 3).

props.name: spotlight
props.doc: Pointer light on cards and bento tiles (default true).

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance (default "up"): a Reveal effect, your own `{ from, to }`, or "none" to switch it off.

hadi-march/landing#FeatureGrid.tr: Özellik ızgarası: `<FeatureGrid items={[{ icon: zap, title: "Hızlı", body: "…" }]} variant="cards" cols={3} />`.

hadi-march/landing#FEED_ENTER.name: FEED_ENTER
hadi-march/landing#FEED_ENTER.doc: Enter presets of LiveFeed: name → keyframes, duration and easing for a new item.
hadi-march/landing#FEED_ENTER.tr: LiveFeed geliş animasyonları: flip, slide, fade, pop, drop, zoom, blur, swing, unfold, glide, spin.

hadi-march/landing#FEED_LEAVE.name: FEED_LEAVE
hadi-march/landing#FEED_LEAVE.doc: Leave presets of LiveFeed: name → keyframes, duration and easing for the item that leaves.
hadi-march/landing#FEED_LEAVE.tr: LiveFeed gidiş animasyonları: blur, fade, shrink, fall, slide, dissolve, fold.

hadi-march/landing#Hero.name: Hero
hadi-march/landing#Hero.doc: `<Hero variant="mesh" eyebrow="New" title="Build faster" highlight="faster" lead="…" actions={[{ label: "Start", href: "/start" }]} />`

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: Small pill above the title ("New: …").

props.name: eyebrowHref
props.doc: Makes the eyebrow a link.

props.name: eyebrowArrow
props.doc: The arrow after a linked eyebrow: true (default "→"), false, or your own node.

props.name: highlight
props.doc: Part of a string title drawn with the brand gradient.

props.name: note
props.doc: Small text under the actions ("No card needed").

props.name: media
props.doc: split / product: an image (size reserved) or any node.

props.name: video
props.type: { src: string; poster?: string | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: video variant.

props.name: layers
props.doc: parallax variant.

props.name: colors
props.doc: Aurora colours (theme tokens by default).

props.name: size
props.doc: md · lg (default) · screen (fills the viewport).

props.name: level
props.doc: Heading level of the title (default 1: the page title; 2 when the hero is not the top of the page).

props.name: backdrop
props.doc: The decorative layers of the variant (grid, mesh, aurora, dots, pointer light, grain): default true; false: none.

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance of the copy (default "up") and of the split media: a Reveal effect, your own `{ from, to }`, or "none".

props.name: frameBar
props.doc: product: the window bar with three dots on the frame (default true).

props.name: tilt
props.doc: product: the frame starts tilted and flattens as you scroll (default true).

hadi-march/landing#Hero.tr: Açılış bölümü: `<Hero variant="mesh" eyebrow="Yeni" title="Daha hızlı kur" highlight="hızlı" lead="…" actions={[…]} />`.

hadi-march/landing#HonestCompare.name: HonestCompare
hadi-march/landing#HonestCompare.doc: `<HonestCompare columns={[{ id: "us", name: "HADİ" }, { id: "a", name: "Other" }]} rows={[{ label: "Offline", values: { us: false, a: true }, note: "Planned for spring" }]} />`

props.name: columns
props.doc: Columns; the one with id `us` is highlighted and scored against the others.

props.name: us
props.doc: Id of the product's own column (default "us").

props.name: caption
props.doc: Table caption (screen readers; shown when `showCaption`).

props.name: summary
props.doc: Show the ahead / even / behind summary and the "only where we are behind" toggle (default true).

props.name: filter
props.doc: The "only where we are behind" toggle in the summary (default true).

props.name: tags
props.doc: The "Ahead" / "Behind" tags beside the row labels (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { yes?: unknown; no?: unknown; partly?: unknown; ahead?: unknown; behind?: unknown; /** Accessible name of the scrolling region (default "Comparison table"). */ region?: string; counts?: (counts: { ahead: number; even: number; behind: number }) => unknown; onlyBehind?: unknown; showAll?: unknown; } | undefined
props.doc: Every text the table writes itself; the defaults are translated. `counts` gets the three numbers.

props.name: renderCell
props.type: ((value: CompareValue, info: { row: CompareRow; column: CompareColumn; us: boolean; verdict: 1 | 0 | -1 | null }) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: Draw a cell yourself: return content, or undefined to keep the default mark. `info.us`: the product's own column; `info.verdict`: how the row scores (1 ahead, 0 even, -1 behind, null not scored).

hadi-march/landing#HonestCompare.tr: Geride kalınan yerleri de gösteren karşılaştırma tablosu: `<HonestCompare columns={[{ id: "us", name: "HADİ" }, …]} rows={[…]} />`.

props.name: panel
props.doc: Panel width (CSS length, default min(80vw, 32rem)).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the region.

props.name: progress
props.doc: The progress line under the panels (default true).

props.name: pinned
props.doc: Pin the section and move the panels with the page scroll (default true); false: always a native sideways scroller with snap points.

hadi-march/landing#LiveCounter.name: LiveCounter
hadi-march/landing#LiveCounter.doc: `<LiveCounter value={$online} label="people online" />`, `<LiveCounter from={12840} rate={30} effect={splitFlap} dotColor="brand-orange" />`

props.name: value
props.doc: The live value (a signal or accessor fed by your data).

props.name: from
props.doc: First value when the counter simulates growth with `rate`.

props.name: rate
props.doc: Average increase per minute (simulated growth when no `value` is given).

props.name: pause
props.doc: Shortest and longest pause between simulated steps, ms (default [1500, 4500]).

props.name: label
props.doc: What is counted: "people online".

props.name: format
props.doc: Intl.NumberFormat options.

props.name: effect
props.doc: How the digits change: "roll" (odometer, default), "none", or a text animation (`effect={scramble}`).

props.name: effectOptions
props.doc: Options for the text animation (`{ duration: 800 }`); a counting one also gets `start`: the previous value.

props.name: dot
props.doc: The live dot: true (default), false, or your own node.

props.name: dotColor
props.doc: Colour of the dot and its pulse (default: success).

props.name: bubble
props.type: boolean | ((diff: number, text: string) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: The "+N" bubble on every increase: true (default), false, or `(diff, text) => content`.

props.name: bubbleColor
props.doc: Colour of the bubble (default: success).

props.name: beat
props.doc: The number beats once on every increase (default true).

props.name: random
props.doc: Random source for the simulated steps (tests).

hadi-march/landing#LiveCounter.tr: Canlı sayaç: `<LiveCounter value={$çevrimiçi} label="kişi şu an" />` ya da `from` + `rate` (dakikada artış) ile ekrandayken büyür.

hadi-march/landing#LiveFeed.name: LiveFeed
hadi-march/landing#LiveFeed.doc: `<LiveFeed next={() => pick(pool)} every={2000} />`, `<LiveFeed items={$events} max={6} variant="wall" />`

props.name: items
props.doc: The items, newest first (reactive: a new first item slides in).

props.name: next
props.doc: Pull one new item; called every `every` ms while the feed is visible and not paused.

props.name: every
props.doc: ms between `next()` calls (default 2400).

props.name: first
props.doc: ms before the first `next()` call (default: `every`); a short one shows the motion at once.

props.name: max
props.doc: Items kept on screen (default 5).

props.name: variant
props.doc: `list` (default): rows, newest on top · `wall`: a grid of cards.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the feed (default "Live activity").

props.name: live
props.doc: Announce new items to screen readers (default "off").

props.name: pausable
props.doc: Show the pause button (default true).

props.name: pauseLabel
props.doc: Text of the pause button while the feed runs (default "Live · pause").

props.name: resumeLabel
props.doc: Text of the pause button while the feed is paused (default "Paused · resume").

props.name: pulse
props.doc: The pulsing dot in the pause button (default true).

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.doc: Pause while the pointer or keyboard focus is inside the feed (default true).

props.name: renderItem
props.doc: Draw an item yourself: the content of its row / card (the feed keeps the list item, its motion and the glow).

props.name: enter
props.doc: How a new item arrives: flip (default), slide, fade, pop, drop, zoom, blur, swing, unfold, glide, spin, "none", or your own keyframes.

props.name: leave
props.doc: How the oldest item leaves: blur (default), fade, shrink, fall, slide, dissolve, fold, "none", or your own keyframes.

props.name: glow
props.doc: Accent ring that glows around a new item and fades (default true).

props.name: move
props.doc: The others glide to their new place (default true); false: they jump.

hadi-march/landing#LiveFeed.tr: Canlı akış: `<LiveFeed next={() => yeniEtkinlik()} every={2400} />` ya da `items={$akış}`; yeni öğe kayarak gelir, üstüne gelince ve düğmeyle durur.

hadi-march/landing#LogoCloud.name: LogoCloud
hadi-march/landing#LogoCloud.doc: `<LogoCloud title="Trusted by" logos={[{ name: "HADİ", src: "/hadi.svg", width: 120, height: 32 }]} variant="marquee" />`

props.name: title
props.doc: Small heading above ("Trusted by teams at").

props.name: mono
props.doc: One muted tone, full colour on hover (default true).

props.name: speed
props.doc: Marquee speed, px/s (default 40).

props.name: reveal
props.doc: grid: entrance of the cells (default "fade"): a Reveal effect, your own `{ from, to }`, or "none".

hadi-march/landing#LogoCloud.tr: Logo bulutu: `<LogoCloud title="Güvenenler" logos={[{ name: "HADİ", src: "/hadiMarka.svg", width: 120, height: 32 }]} variant="marquee" />`.

hadi-march/landing#Newsletter.name: Newsletter
hadi-march/landing#Newsletter.doc: `<Newsletter title="Stay in the loop" onSubmit={(email) => api.subscribe(email)} note="No spam." />`

props.name: onSubmit
props.doc: Save the address; throw (or reject) to show an error.

props.name: button
props.doc: Button text (default "Subscribe").

props.name: note
props.doc: Small print under the form (privacy note).

props.name: done
props.doc: Shown after success (default "Thanks! Check your inbox.").

props.name: labels
props.type: { /** Accessible name of the field (default "Email address"). */ email?: string; /** Message for an address that is not valid. */ invalid?: string; /** Message when `onSubmit` fails without a message of its own. */ error?: string; } | undefined
props.doc: The other texts the form writes itself; the defaults are translated.

props.name: doneIcon
props.doc: The check mark of the success line: true (default), false, or your own node.

props.name: motion
props.doc: The shake on an error and the fold / pop on success (default true); false: the states just change.

hadi-march/landing#Newsletter.tr: Bülten kaydı: `<Newsletter title="Haberdar ol" onSubmit={(email) => api.subscribe(email)} note="Spam yok." />`.
